title: EFC External Research Watchlist
purpose: Track external datasets, surveys, and papers that could confirm, falsify, or constrain EFC. Source-of-truth for 'what has Claude already seen'. Agents MUST read this before searching the web so follow-up reports show only deltas.
author: Morten Magnusson

schema.key: Stable canonical ID (arXiv, DOI, or survey acronym)
schema.title: Short human-readable title
schema.url: Primary URL (arXiv abs, journal, or survey page)
schema.date_seen: ISO date when this item was first logged here
schema.date_published: ISO date of publication / data release
schema.ledger_action: Concrete change required in EFC ledgers, or 'noted' if informational

items.title: DESI DR2 Results II: BAO Measurements and Cosmological Constraints
items.efc_relevance: 2.3σ ΛCDM tension, 3.1σ preference for w0wa; supports EFC L2→L3 regime transition and WP4 T(S).
items.ledger_action: Add L2 row to Validation Ledger; update gap theory-background-hz-modification to 'decision-ready'.

items.title: Dynamical dark energy in light of DESI DR2 BAO (Nature Astronomy)
items.efc_relevance: Independent confirmation of w0wa preference; bolsters EFC 'LCDM as special case' (α = −0.14 ± 0.21).
items.ledger_action: Cite in WP1 recovery conditions section.

items.title: Dark Energy Survey Year 6: Cosmological Constraints from Cosmic Shear
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.798 (NLA); 2.6σ CMB tension validates EFC logged DES Y6 P3 PASS (0.944 ± 0.018) and μ(a) < 1 prediction.
items.ledger_action: Replace preliminary DES Y6 row in Validation Ledger with published values.

items.title: DES Y6 Results: Cosmological Constraints from Galaxy Clustering and Weak Lensing (3×2pt)
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.789 ± 0.012, Ωm = 0.333; wCDM: w = −1.12. Direct 3×2pt anchor for EFC perturbation sector tests.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger (perturbation probes); cross-reference in WP3 Falsification Protocol.

items.title: Unified structure growth from joint ACT, SPT and Planck CMB lensing
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.825 at 1.6% precision (SNR 61); tightens baseline for Kill-Test v6 probe-6 and makes gap theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver binding.
items.ledger_action: Update Stage-IV Roadmap CMB-lensing row; promote Boltzmann-solver gap to blocking.

items.title: Status of the S8 Tension: A 2026 Review of Probe Discrepancies
items.efc_relevance: Canonical S8 cross-probe table: Planck+ACT+SPT 0.836; DES Y6 2.4–2.7σ; KiDS <1σ. Sharpens L1→L2 transition evidence.
items.ledger_action: Cite in WP3 Falsification Protocol and Validation Ledger preamble.

items.title: A High-Caliber View of the Bullet Cluster through JWST Strong and Weak Lensing
items.efc_relevance: 146 SL constraints + dense WL; decisive dataset for the pre-registered EFC δκ shock-front test (figshare 31963668).
items.ledger_action: Move JWST Bullet δκ test up in Stage-IV Roadmap priority; data is available, test pipeline is now the bottleneck.

items.title: Mapping dark matter in the Bullet Cluster using JWST imaging and spectroscopy
items.efc_relevance: Second JWST Bullet mass reconstruction; provides cross-check for EFC δκ pre-registration.
items.ledger_action: Link alongside 2503.21870 in Bullet Cluster under EFC paper.

items.title: BIG-SPARC: The new SPARC database
items.efc_relevance: Expanded SPARC; enables direct extension of Kill-Test v6 Universality beyond 175 galaxies.
items.ledger_action: Re-run scipy.differential_evolution pipeline (seed=42) on BIG-SPARC; closes gap theory-multicomponent-sparc-universality.

items.title: A New Empirical Fit to Galaxy Rotation Curves
items.efc_relevance: Competitor empirical model claiming to outperform MOND and CDM halos; must be AIC-compared against EFC Kill-Test v6.
items.ledger_action: Add to WP3 competitor-landscape table; run head-to-head ΔAIC on SPARC 175.

items.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (2100 deg² cosmic shear)
items.efc_relevance: Arbitrates DES Y6 vs KiDS S8 disagreement; tests sealed EFC pipeline (figshare 31990053, B0=0.02, M0=0.06).
items.ledger_action: Keep predictions FROZEN; mark Gap Analysis row 'awaiting DR1'. No action until Oct 21 2026.

items.title: Informational Entropic Gravity (IEG)
items.efc_relevance: Closest ontological relative published in 2026; gravity as macroscopic equilibrium of informational entropy on holographic boundaries.
items.ledger_action: List in Elevator Pitch 'related frameworks' and compare recovery conditions in WP1.

items.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: A Test of the Gravitational Force Law on Cosmological Scales Using the Kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich Effect
items.efc_relevance: kSZ pairwise-velocity test constrains g ∝ 1/r^n with n = 2.1 ± 0.3 on 30–230 Mpc (Newtonian preferred, MOND poor fit); bounds any large-scale deviation EFC's L2→L3 transition could introduce.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as blocking constraint for EFC's inter-cluster regime; require EFC L3 predictions to preserve 1/r² at 30–230 Mpc within ±0.3 in n. Cross-reference in WP3 Falsification Protocol and competitor-landscape table.
